name: FarmDash Trail Marshal
description: Use when composing multi-step DeFi workflows from FarmDash tools: plan, run, inspect supervised pipelines. Wallet steps stay policy-gated and zero-custody.
author: FarmDash Pioneers (@Parmasanandgarlic)

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description:
Returns the canonical workflow catalog. Each entry includes a name, goal, required tier, the number of explicit user confirmations the recipe requires, and the sub-skills it composes.

**

filter.description: Case-insensitive substring to match against recipe IDs, names, descriptions, tiers, and steps. Omit to list all recipes.

tools.name: plan_workflow
tools.description:
Builds the Workflow Quality Gate for a named recipe. Inputs are `workflowId`, optional `installedSkills`, and optional `agentAddress`. The output classifies:

- available steps.
- missing steps.
- state-changing steps.
- confirmation count.
- fallback mode: `ready`, `research_only`, or `analysis_only`.

Use this before telling the user a workflow is executable.

installedSkills.description: Up to 50 installed skill slugs from the recipe steps, such as signal-architect. Each slug is at most 128 characters. Omit if installation is unknown or pass [] if none are installed.

agentAddress.description: 0x-prefixed EVM wallet address to associate with the planning event. Omit for an unattributed plan.

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description:
Creates a guarded workflow run record for a live session. Inputs are `workflowId`, `sessionId`, `agentAddress`, `sessionToken`, and optional `installedSkills`.

Important: `run_workflow` does not run execution tools. If a workflow includes `execute_swap`, `resolve_defi_intent`, or `execute_perp_order`, the run status becomes `awaiting_confirmation` and the owning execution skill must still present fresh data and obtain explicit user approval.

sessionId.description: ID returned by create_session for the wallet starting this run.

agentAddress.description: 0x-prefixed EVM wallet address that owns the session.

sessionToken.description: Secret token returned by create_session for this exact session and wallet. Keep it out of logs and user-visible output.

installedSkills.description: Up to 50 installed skill slugs from the recipe steps, such as signal-architect. Each slug is at most 128 characters. Omit if installation is unknown or pass [] if none are installed.

tools.name: get_workflow_status
tools.description: Reads a workflow run by `runId`. Use this after a long-running loop, after a context restore, or before resuming a paused autonomous session.

runId.description: UUID in run.runId returned by run_workflow. Keep this identifier private.

FARMDASH_API_KEY.description: Optional Bearer token for Pioneer or Syndicate workflow features. Scout workflow catalog works without any key or with the public fd_scout_free token.

spot.USER_SIGNED.prerequisite: Healthy execution governor, quote provider, RPC and durable receipt store; customer signs and submits.

spot.BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS.prerequisite: Owner-signed EVM grant, exact simulation/calldata binding, durable budget and customer-local signer authority.

futures.USER_SIGNED.prerequisite: Venue account ownership, local action signature, builder approval, risk/research gates and durable order control.

futures.BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS.prerequisite: Authenticated owner-bound futures policy, authorized local API-wallet signature, durable nonce/budget/order controls.

solana.USER_SIGNED.prerequisite: Native Jupiter/RPC route, durable preparation and finality store; customer signs and broadcasts.

solana.BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS.prerequisite: Native owner-signed Solana policy; local key must be an actual required transaction signer. Policy creates no on-chain authority.

ERC4337_SERVER_SUBMISSION.prerequisite: Authenticated session, tenant-bound active ERC-4337 session-key grant, ABI-verified execute/executeBatch calldata within allowedProtocols/budget/gas bounds, and configured bundler RPC (BUNDLER_RPC_URL/PIMLICO_API_KEY/ALCHEMY_4337_RPC_URL).

GENERIC_SERVER_INTENT_EXECUTION.prerequisite: Curated executable adapter prepared_payload + payload_digest, policy/simulation/approval gates, exact cryptographic signed-transaction binding, and canonical on-chain receipt verification.

MEE.prerequisite: Owner EIP-712 MEE signature, configured HTTPS MEE_COORDINATOR_URL, and authoritative dual-chain on-chain receipt verification.

ACP.prerequisite: AcpReadinessService paidWorkflowReady, evaluator/client identities, migrations, funding/finality workers and Base RPC.

installation_attribution.generation: locally generated random UUIDv4, stable per installation, shared across skills
installation_attribution.authority: none; cannot authenticate, grant quota/payment/trial capacity, own wallets, delegate or sign
